    Direct arrow and mesh partitions for primitive deletion #

    This file formalizes the finite partitions used in the live manuscript's direct count. Every ambient arrow occurrence is internal to the killed subcategory, internal to its complement, or crosses the boundary. Every ambient nonprojective mesh likewise has both translation endpoints killed, both surviving, or on opposite sides.
